JW Calendar 0.1.0 brings an offline-first calendar and date utility to Linux.

- CLI month and year calendars with Sunday- or Monday-first layouts.
- Date details with weekday, ordinal day, leap-year status and ISO week-year.
- Separate tools for Julian calendar dates, Julian Day Numbers and day-of-year values.
- US federal holiday reference with legal and observed dates.
- Native GTK desktop month view, year overview, date details and JW Calendar resource links.
- Strict-confinement Snap package.

Install from the Snap Store with:

```sh
sudo snap install jwcalendar
```
